title: Black Flies of the Oriental Region
subtitle: Identification keys, species pages and terminology
rank_conventions: All Oriental species are placed in Simulium; subgenera and species-groups follow Takaoka and co-authors (current Thai checklist) unless a newer source in sources.csv says otherwise (log the difference in conflicts.csv). Cytoforms/cytospecies are noted on species pages, not keyed.
home_intro_html:
Black flies (Simuliidae) are small, stout-bodied biting flies whose larvae and pupae live in running water. Females of some species transmit Onchocerca filariae and Leucocytozoon blood parasites. Identification uses the adult (female and male), the pupa (gill filaments, cocoon) and the mature larva.

This site brings together the published dichotomous keys for the Oriental Region and updates them with later taxonomic work on Thailand and neighbouring countries.
glossary_intro_html: Terms follow current black fly morphology as used in the keys on this site; where older keys use other terms, both are listed. Thumbnails open the illustrating figure.
